first_line: Your ChatGPT ads spent $13,783.00 for 214 conversions in the last 30 days and beat Google Search on cost per conversion ($64.41 vs $92.20), but Clinics | Paid plans | US spent $2,145.00 with 0 conversions because its event source sends nothing.

scorecard.why: Active, review and integrity review approved; 4 campaigns active, 1 paused. Spend rose over 20%, led by Clinics | Paid plans | US (+$1,295.00), which was created on 2026-09-15.
It took 15.56% of spend with a conversion setting and no conversions. The clicks campaign has weak CTR and no measurement.
Every campaign has an ad group and every group has an approved ad. One ad was rejected and one has under half its group's CTR.
Both campaigns above the 30-conversion floor are under target (0.85x and 0.79x). ROAS on paid plans is 3.64.

scorecard.key_number: 1 of 2 sources returns no events, and a live campaign uses it
scorecard.why: The website pixel records page views, demo requests and paid plans. The server source sends nothing, and the clinics campaign bids on it.
All ready with no invalid identifiers. Paying customers is too small to target; 2 audiences are used by no ad group.
get_lead_forms and get_lead_sync_subscriptions returned 403. Demo requests are tracked through the pixel instead.

scorecard.area: 8. ChatGPT Ads vs Google Search Ads
scorecard.why: Both sides clear every volume floor. ChatGPT Ads wins on CPA, ROAS, CPC and CPM; Google wins on CTR and conversion rate.

scorecard.key_number: Booking software | Paid plans | US reaches its cap about 2026-11-06
scorecard.why: The other active campaigns have 26.7 days or more of runway, or are on pace for their end date. Projections are estimates at the last 7 days' run rate.

ranking_rule: Fails first, then warns; within each group by spend touched in the window, highest first; ties keep area order.

top_findings.finding: Clinics | Paid plans | US took 15.56% of spend and recorded 0 conversions
top_findings.evidence: get_ad_account_insights: $2,145.00 of $13,783.00, 1,950 clicks; get_conversion_insights: 0 conversions, 0 view-through.
top_findings.what_to_do: Pause it now. The cause is in area 5: its event setting reads a source that returns no events.

top_findings.finding: Clinics | Paid plans | US bids on conversions from a source that sends no events
top_findings.evidence: get_event_settings: Paid plan started (server) (order_created) reads Server events (Conversions API) (cds_example0002); get_conversion_events for pid ExBkServer02 returned 0 events, while the website pixel returned 104 order_created events in the same window.
top_findings.what_to_do: Fix the server integration so it sends order_created with the same event id as the pixel, and check get_conversion_events again. The setting can't be swapped on this campaign, so if the server events can't be fixed this week, rebuild it on the Paid plan started setting.
top_findings.who: do this on your site, then in ChatGPT Ads Manager

top_findings.finding: Booking software | Paid plans | US is on track to hit its lifetime cap about 2026-11-06, 24 days before its end date
top_findings.evidence: Spend to date $15,430.00 of a $18,000 cap (85.72%); last 7 days average $262.00 a day; 34 days to 2026-11-30. Projection (an estimate at that run rate): $24,338.00.
top_findings.what_to_do: Raise the cap to $24,400 if the campaign should run to its end date, or let it stop and move the money. It is the best-performing campaign (area 4).

top_findings.finding: Ad "Take deposits when clients book" has a CTR of 0.75%, under half its ad group's 1.6%
top_findings.evidence: get_ad_account_insights by ad: 80,000 impressions, 600 clicks, $720.00; ad group Owners comparing booking software: 300,000 impressions, 4,800 clicks.
top_findings.what_to_do: Pause it and let the stronger ad in the group take its impressions, then test a new deposits angle against it.

top_findings.finding: Fitness studios | Clicks | US has a CTR of 0.5%, under half the account's 1.24%
top_findings.evidence: get_ad_account_insights by campaign: 180,000 impressions, 900 clicks; account CTR 1.24% on 1,000,000 impressions.
top_findings.what_to_do: Rewrite the ads and context hints toward booking questions people ask in ChatGPT, or move the budget to the paid-plan campaign. This is a clicks campaign, so CTR is its main measure.
top_findings.who: do this in ChatGPT Ads Manager

other_findings.finding: Fitness studios | Clicks | US spent $540.00 with no conversion setting
other_findings.evidence: get_campaigns: conversion_event_setting_ids is empty; get_ad_account_insights: $540.00 spend in the window.
other_findings.what_to_do: Settings can't be added to an existing campaign. If these clicks should turn into sign-ups, build its replacement with the Paid plan started setting attached at creation.
other_findings.who: do this in ChatGPT Ads Manager

other_findings.finding: Ad "Free salon booking page, no catch" was rejected in review
other_findings.evidence: get_ads: review_status rejected in ad group Salon owners, which still has 1 approved ad.
other_findings.what_to_do: The API doesn't return the rejection reason, so open the ad in Ads Manager, rewrite it to fix the stated reason and resubmit it. The group keeps serving on its approved ad meanwhile.
other_findings.who: do this in ChatGPT Ads Manager

other_findings.finding: Event setting "Pricing page view" is linked to no campaign
other_findings.evidence: get_event_settings: page_viewed on Website pixel, campaigns list empty.
other_findings.what_to_do: Leave it unlinked or archive it in Ads Manager. A page view counts visits, not sign-ups, so it should not be a campaign's goal.
other_findings.who: do this in ChatGPT Ads Manager

other_findings.finding: Audience "Paying customers" is under 25k matched users
other_findings.evidence: get_custom_audiences: matched_user_count_range under_25k; no ad group bid multiplier uses it.
other_findings.what_to_do: Use it as an exclusion on the paid-plan campaigns, so existing customers stop seeing sign-up ads. It is too small to target or bid on.
other_findings.who: do this in ChatGPT Ads Manager
